message:
1 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:34: interpolation reads `m` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence a `@let` holds, bound two-way to an input of a directive on an `<ng-template>` (`[(value)]`), which draws the template with the value as the implicit one (measured: drawn). The compiler matches a two-way binding to a directive's input as it matches a property binding, and a template's variable stands for it too.
